text:
Jordan: Heads up — I'm taking the sunset handoff at 19:00 UTC, but I'll be on a conference call 19:30–20:15. Need someone to be primary during that window. Primary = page first, Secondary = backup. Anyone available? :wave:
Maya: I can cover 19:30–20:15 as primary. Will keep Slack and phone on. Who's secondary?
Sam: I can be secondary until 21:00. If anything customer-impacting, page me immediately. Quick reminder of escalation timing: page primary -> 5m -> page secondary -> 10m -> escalate to eng-sre.
Devon: Note — we have a flapping sign on shard-7 from earlier today. If you see 503s, follow the shard-flap runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/infra/shard-flap. Also check autoscaler and recent deploys.
Jordan: Thanks. I'll update the handoff note and add runbook links. Also who has monitor access for the dedicated cluster?
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident #2468 triggered at 1768001225 — API latency spike detected in prod-west (embeddings path). Current: elevated p95/p99, error rate still low.
Maya: I'm seeing the same in Grafana. Dashboards show p99 ~2.6x baseline. No spike in 5xx yet.
Sam: Treat as potential customer impact — if p99 stays >2x for >10m escalate. Start triage: check pods, autoscaler, and KV cache hit rates.
Maya: On it — checking autoscaler logs now. No recent scale events in the last 15m. Running quick log check:
```bash
kubectl -n prod logs deployment/inference-embedder-7 --since=10m | grep -i error | tail -n 20
```
Sam: Also verify redis metrics: hitrate, evictions, memory. If hit rate drops, it's a warming or eviction issue.
Devon: If you need pager rules quick: Page primary for any 5xx >0.5% sustained or p99 >2x baseline for >10m. If primary doesn't ACK in 5m, page secondary. If secondary also unresponsive or issue broadens (multi-region), escalate to eng-sre PD and call the bridge. Runbook excerpt:
```text
SEV1: customer-facing outage (5xx >1% or total outage) -> PD:eng-sre-all, open bridge, notify CSMs
SEV2: severe degradation (p99 >2x baseline for >10m) -> PD:eng-oncall, page secondary after 5m, prepare rollback candidates
```
Maya: If p99 still high at 19:40 I'll escalate to PD. I'm watching CPU and tail latency now.
Jordan: tagging for PD (if needed) — @pagerduty-eng. Use PD to call bridge if we hit SEV1.
incident-bot: Reminder: Handoff checklist missing "phone holder" field for tonight. Please update before 19:00 so pager fallback is clear.
Sam: Updated handoff doc with primary/secondary, phone holder, and escalation matrix: https://docs.redwood/internal/oncall/handoffs/sunset-2026 (added runbook links and PD playbook).
Maya: If I need to trigger PagerDuty, the quick command is: `/pd trigger "Prod-west p99 spike" --service inference-api --urgency high` — that'll page PD and open the incident.
Jordan: Great. Final summary: Maya = primary 19:30–20:15, Sam = secondary until 21:00, Devon = infra support. If any 5xx or sustained p99 >2x for 10m -> page PD. I'll DM the phone numbers and bridge details. :thumbsup:
